title: Retry production deployment and update public URL reference

requirements.text: Retry deploying the current latest version of the Chocolate Day application to production via the platform deployment flow, and provide the updated public production URL once deployment succeeds.
acceptanceCriteria: A new production deployment attempt is executed for the latest code.
If deployment succeeds, a public production URL is produced and shared as the result of the deployment.
If deployment fails again, capture and surface the deployment error details so the failure cause is actionable.

requirements.text: After a successful deployment, update frontend/PRODUCTION_URL.txt to replace the placeholder URL and timestamp with the actual production URL and the time of update (English text only).
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/PRODUCTION_URL.txt contains the real production URL (not the placeholder).
frontend/PRODUCTION_URL.txt contains a filled-in 'Last Updated' timestamp (not the placeholder).

constraints: Do not modify any immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.frontend.immutablePaths.
Keep backend logic within the single Motoko actor (backend/main.mo); only add migration.mo if an upgrade requires state migration.
nonGoals: Do not add or change application features, UI, content, or styling beyond what is necessary to complete deployment and record the URL.
Do not introduce any new backend APIs or persistent state as part of this request.
